title: Stacked priority hits — Marta's midday pipeline pad
content:
Context / goal:
- Burn through 12 warm leads & 5 follow-ups before EOD. Prioritize deals with active evals or legal review open.
- Test two new hooks for dedicated capacity (pricing + prediction latency) and log responses.

Morning recap (what worked):
- Short subject lines (<=6 words) got 18% open vs 11% on long ones.
- Quick time-to-value pitch (1 line + CTA) converted 2 discovery calls from trial accounts.

Today windows (timeboxed):
- 09:00–10:30: Live dials (priority list A) — 8 accounts
- 11:00–11:30: Follow-up blitz (emails + LinkedIn) — 5 accounts
- 14:00–15:00: Demo syncs / calendar holds
- 16:30–17:30: End-of-day wrap, log notes, nudge open trials

Priority A (call sequence — instant connect attempt -> VM -> email template 1):
1) Synapse Metrics (POC active — cloud audit ticket) — contact: Priya Rao (Dir. Eng) — best hook: "drop per-token cost 30% for inference-heavy queries" — key ask: get 30-min product sync; blocker: procurement timeline unknown — next: call now, if VM then email with benchmark snippet.
2) Helix Insights (trial user: 3 seats) — contact: Marcus Li (ML Eng) — hook: "latency SLOs at half cost" — note: asked for architecture diagram last week — next: push follow-up w/ diagram link.
3) Coyote Health (security review open) — contact: Elena Park (Head of Infra) — hook: Private deployment + KMS integration — note: legal asked for SOC2 artifacts — next: ping solutions eng (Sofia) for an artifacts bundle, include in follow-up.
4) TradeWorx (inbound via webinar) — contact: Omar Grant (PM) — hook: dedicated GPU pools for peak load — next: calendar propose Tue/Thu 10am.
5) NimbusVR (startup, limited budget) — contact: Rafael Gomez (CTO) — quick pitch: staged rollout: hosted -> dedicated (cost predictability) — next: offer trial extension til end of month.
6) ParcelAI (referred by SE) — contact: Anika Bose (Eng Manager) — hook: batch caching for throughput gains — next: send short results slide, request call.
7) QuarryData (slow reply) — contact: Ben Ivy (Analyst) — hook: embeddings rerank demo clip — next: leave VM + email w/ 45s clip link.
8) Verdant Media (previously lost) — contact: Samir Patel (Head Product) — hook: new rollout/canary features — next: test re-engagement with A/B case study.

Follow-up queue (email templates / subject ideas):
- Subject A: "Quick note on reducing inference costs — Marta from Redwood"
- Subject B: "Follow-up: private deploy artifacts for Coyote Health"

Snippets to paste (short):
- Quick value line: "We typically cut per-token inference spend by 20–40% via caching + batching in 2 weeks, with identical output quality."
- CTA: "Are you free for a 20-min sync this week to see if this maps to your infra?"

Micro-scripts for calls (30–60s):
- Intro (15s): "Hi — Marta from Redwood Inference. We help teams ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower inference cost. Quick Q: who owns inference SLAs on your side?"
- Hook (20s): "We recently helped a company like yours move from fluctuating hosted spend to a dedicated profile and reduced 95th-percentile latency by ~40% — curious if your latency spikes are painful?"
- Close (10s): "If it matters, can we book 20 to dig into your metrics?"

Tracking quick-status (tick when done):
- [ ] Called priority A list (mark times + connect results)
- [ ] Sent follow-up emails for items 1–5
- [ ] Slack to SE for artifact bundle (Coyote Health)
- [ ] Update CRM with next steps + expected close window

Objections cheat-sheet (one-liners):
- "We can’t change our infra": "Can we run a small POC in parallel without changing infra?"
- "Too expensive": "We model potential dollar savings based on your token mix—can I send a snapshot analysis?"
- "Security concerns": "We offer private deploy + KMS + audit logs; I’ll loop in security enablement."

Notes to self / experiments to run today:
- A/B test subject A vs B on follow-ups (tag responses in CRM)
- Try sending 45s demo clip vs PDF slide; note consumption and reply rate
- Time calls with calendar nudges 24h before (auto-resend from sequence)

End-of-day wrap (what to log):
- Call outcomes + 1-line summary for each account (what they asked for next)
- Update trial statuses & move any hot leads to sequence B
- Draft short recap for AE standup tomorrow (3 bullets: wins, blockers, asks)

Random friction points to escalate:
- Coyote legal needs SOC2 section; escalate to Solutions + Security (Sofia)
- Synapse wants benchmark reproduction — ask infra-eng for test harness

Quick reminder: ping Liam re: new case study slide deck (internal link in Confluence).

-- end pad --

(keeping this light — copy snippets into CRM notes rather than pasting whole doc)
